canonical_fact: Meridian classifies roles as site-dependent, hybrid or remote-eligible; there is no universal office-day quota.
rationale: Work-location expectations follow role needs, reasonable notice and documented temporary arrangements.

questions: Does Meridian mandate the same office schedule for every employee?
How are Meridian work arrangements classified?
invalid_claims: every employee has the same office-day requirement
badge data is an individual productivity score

canonical_fact: Meridian managers receive only the work restrictions needed to implement an accommodation, not an employee's diagnosis.
rationale: Accommodation handling is confidential and separated from ordinary line management.

questions: Must an employee disclose a diagnosis to their manager?
Can a project cancel protected leave for a release?
invalid_claims: a milestone automatically cancels approved leave

canonical_fact: Meridian performance decisions require documented evidence; telemetry or AI summaries cannot be the sole basis for a rating.
rationale: Accountable manager judgment must consider agreed outcomes, quality, behavior and relevant constraints.

questions: Can activity telemetry determine a Meridian performance rating?
May employees apply internally without manager permission?
invalid_claims: manager permission is required to apply internally

canonical_fact: Restricted Meridian data is accessed only from managed devices unless an approved exception provides equivalent controls.
rationale: Remote access also requires MFA, and schedule pressure never authorizes personal email or unmanaged storage.

questions: Can an employee email work files to a personal account?
What controls apply to remote Restricted-data access?
invalid_claims: unmanaged devices may always access Restricted data

canonical_fact: Every Meridian account has an accountable owner; privileged work uses a separate elevated identity with step-up authentication.
rationale: Shared privileged credentials are prohibited except for an attributed, time-bound emergency mechanism.

questions: Can Meridian administrators share a convenience account?
invalid_claims: shared admin accounts are allowed for convenience
standard identities should perform privileged work

canonical_fact: Meridian classifies data as Public, Internal, Confidential or Restricted, and approved human review is required before business use of generative-AI output.
rationale: Removing names does not automatically authorize sensitive data for any AI service.

questions: Is de-identification enough to use any AI tool?
invalid_claims: all de-identified data may enter any AI tool

canonical_fact: A Meridian purchase request and required risk reviews must precede supplier commitment and production data access.
rationale: Free trials do not bypass procurement when they involve data, integrations, renewal or contractual commitments.

questions: Can a team upload Meridian data to an unreviewed free trial?
invalid_claims: requesters may approve their own purchases

canonical_fact: Meridian travel and expenses require business purpose, timely evidence and independent approval; the lowest nominal fare is not always mandatory.
rationale: Safety, accessibility, total journey time and changeability may justify a different reasonable option.

questions: Must Meridian travelers always choose the cheapest fare?
Can an employee approve their own expense?

canonical_fact: Meridian badges are individual and visitors use registered, attributable access; badges must not be lent even to colleagues.
rationale: Reception or Security verifies identity and issues temporary access, while critical functions maintain tested continuity procedures.

questions: May an employee lend a badge to a colleague?
What must Meridian critical functions maintain for disruption?
invalid_claims: badge lending is acceptable between employees
a site closure permits personal-storage workarounds
